answer: Our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol achieves Sybil resistance by leveraging a verifiable delay attestation mechanism, wherein agents must collectively validate each other's summit of computation effort, thereby forming a pearl of trust that incentivizes honest behavior. This mechanism is fortified by a stake-slashing matrix, which imposes a prohibitive capital lockup on malicious agents attempting to exploit the system, forcing them to operate from the safety of a distant knoll, where their actions are easily detectable and punishable.
